newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends firmer, off day's high amid weak Dow.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends firmer, off day's high amid weak Dow.

text.p: The leading FTSE 100 index managed to hold just above the 4,300 level at the close on Wednesday after a strong showing from UK retailers combined with relief that the Federal Reserve did not tighten U.S. credit more aggressively bolstered investor confidence, dealers said.
The benchmark FTSE 100 index added 30.8 points to 4,301.5, as advancers outpaced decliners by a margin of about two to one.
But UK shares slipped from the day's best levels as Wall Street faltered.
